Official record function: Final work PDF and version identity
Bachelor’s route: Mandatory. Transmit the final bachelor’s thesis through the current official route. The reviewed, transmitted and defended copies must have the same content. Current file-naming and channel rules are volatile. Authority: C1, C4, C6, C8 and C9.
Master’s route: Mandatory. Transmit the final dissertation through the current official route. The reviewed, transmitted and defended copies must have the same content. Current file-naming and channel rules are volatile. Authority: C2, C5, C7, C8 and C9.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the exact PDF, cryptographic hash, upload or transmission receipt, report identifier and department acknowledgement. A file on disk without receipt is not transmission evidence.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory. The thesis is checked through the institutional route and the supervisor decides Admitted or Rejected after analysing the report. Authority: C1 and C9.
Master’s route: Mandatory. The dissertation is checked through the institutional route and the supervisor decides Admitted or Rejected after analysing the report. Authority: C2 and C9.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain report identity, reviewed-file hash, decision, date and any authorised correction cycle. Do not treat a numerical coefficient as an automatic originality verdict.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory. Use the current application, dated and signed as required. The title must match the approved title and the final work. Authority: C1 and C6.
Master’s route: Mandatory. Use the current application, dated and signed as required. The title must match the approved title and the final work. Authority: C2 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the exact submitted copy and submission evidence. A title mismatch is a package-identity defect, not a typographical detail.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory. Use the current official declaration, dated and signed. Authority: C1 and C6.
Master’s route: Mandatory. Use the current official declaration, dated and signed. Authority: C2 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the submitted copy in the restricted administrative dossier. Do not place signed personal forms in a public repository or companion release.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory. Use the current official declaration, dated and signed. Authority: C1 and C6.
Master’s route: Mandatory. Use the current official declaration, dated and signed. Authority: C2 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the submitted copy and confirm that it refers to the same final work. The declaration supplements, rather than replaces, source and similarity controls.

Bachelor’s route: Conditional. Use the current authenticity declaration when an officially activated electronic bachelor’s route requires it. Authority: C1 and the current faculty instruction.
Master’s route: Mandatory under the current master’s regulation and checked CSIE route. Use the current declaration, dated and signed, for documents transmitted electronically. Authority: C2 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the exact signed declaration, the transmitted document set and the transmission evidence together. The declaration does not cure an altered, incomplete or mismatched file set.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory. Declare use or non-use, insert the declaration immediately after Contents and submit the separate signed copy required at registration. Authority: C3 and C6.
Master’s route: Mandatory. Declare use or non-use, insert the declaration immediately after Contents and submit the separate signed copy required at registration. Authority: C3 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the in-work version and the exact signed submission copy. Use the current form; Annex 3 versus Annex 3.1 is a known implementation inconsistency, not a permanent number.

Official record function: Clearance, employability and session survey evidence
Bachelor’s route: Mandatory under C1: clearance and employability evidence. Mandatory in the checked CSIE session notice: satisfaction evidence. Reverify the later session. Authority: C1 and C6.
Master’s route: Mandatory under C2: clearance and employability evidence. Mandatory in the checked CSIE session notice: satisfaction evidence. Reverify the later session. Authority: C2 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain completed forms or the evidence format required by the current route, including confirmation or screenshot where expressly requested. Do not assume that a questionnaire submission is visible to the secretariat without proof.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory in the checked CSIE notice: current identity copy. Conditional: civil-status evidence where the name differs. Reverify quantity and naming instructions. Authority: C6.
Master’s route: Mandatory in the checked CSIE notice: current identity copy. Conditional: residence evidence for an electronic identity card and civil-status evidence where the name differs. Authority: C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain only the submission checklist or restricted submitted copy for as long as legitimately required. Never copy identity records into GitHub, Zenodo or the public companion.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory under the current bachelor’s regulation. The checked notice specifies current size, medium and labelling, all of which must be reverified. Authority: C1 and C6.
Master’s route: Not a universal requirement in the checked master’s regulation and CSIE master’s notice. Do not import the bachelor’s requirement. Authority: C2 and C7.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain a dossier checklist or receipt, not an unnecessary digital image of the photographs. Apply the current official quantity and format.

Bachelor’s route: Mandatory control outcome. Incomplete dossiers are not accepted and the secretariat confirms document verification and registration. Authority: C1 and the current faculty route.
Master’s route: Mandatory control outcome. Incomplete dossiers are not accepted and the candidate must verify the registration confirmation. Authority: C2 and the current faculty route.
Verifier and recommended retention: Retain the confirmation message, status or equivalent official evidence. Submission evidence alone is not proof of completed registration.
